messages:
Alex R.: quick check — staging node thermals + reservation handoff. noticed 2x pending reservations for dedicated-2026 that mention "node-45" but we never wound up activating it. who owns the final bringup?
Priya S.: @Alex R. I was triaging rack B yesterday. node-45 was marked DOA by HW team, replaced with node-47. reservation probably pointed at the old host. :grimacing:
Marco (infra): correct. HW ticket #HW-9182 — node-45 fan assembly failed. node-47 is live but not added to the reservation pool yet. I can add it but need confirmation on the thermal guardrails we're using for staging.
Alex R.: thanks. what are the staging thermal SLOs again? I saw a transient spike to 82C on one run last night. is that acceptable for smoke?
Jen ops: staging SLOs are: sustained avg <= 75C, short spikes allowed up to 85C for < 5 mins. but anything > 80C that causes throttling we mark and investigate. that 82C sounds borderline. did it throttle?
Priya S.: it briefly throttled on step 3 of the burnin (kf-run-2026-03). logs show `gpu_util 97%` and `clock_throttle: 1` for ~90s. pasted snippet: ```[2026-03-14T02:14:12Z] node-47 gpu0 temp=82.1C gpu_util=97 throttle=1```
Marco (infra): node-47 came with older BIOS which didn't have the fan curve fix. i pushed BIOS v2.1.4 this morning — should flatten those spikes. i can re-run the burnin tonight.
Alex R.: great. on the reservation side: there are two pending reservations in the portal, both pointing to dedicated-2026 project. one explicitly references node-45 in the metadata. @Marco (infra) can you update the reservations to target node-47 or mark them as "awaiting-ops"?
Marco (infra): will do. plan: (1) update reservation metadata to node-47, (2) kick a re-run of the smoke job, (3) if thermals stable, flip reservation to active. i'll tag ops when step 2 passes.
Jen ops: when you flip it active, please also set capacity-tier=burst for the first 24h so the scheduler won't route production traffic. i'll handle the canary routing and make sure traffic stays internal.
Priya S.: FYI QA flagged one test that flakes under 80C — pinged test-owner @Sam but low priority until thermals stable.
deploy-bot: [bot] reservation-update request queued: resctl update --id res-3392 --target node-47 --meta "capacity-tier=burst;owner=eng-staging" (job #4493)
Alex R.: perfect. timeline? if Marco re-runs burnin tonight and passes, can we have reservation active by tomorrow morning (UTC)? we need to validate a throughput test at 10:00 UTC.
Marco (infra): yes — re-run at 23:30 UTC tonight, expect ~90m. if all green, i'll flip to active by 08:00 UTC and ping here. if BIOS patch causes any regressions i'll roll back and escalate.
Jen ops: noted. i'll add a calendar hold for 09:30-11:00 UTC for the throughput window and disable autoscaling to keep tests deterministic.
Alex R.: thanks everyone. next actions: Marco updates reservation metadata + run burnin; Jen sets calendar + routing; Priya follows up on QA flakes. tag me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Marco (infra): will update by 23:45 UTC at latest.
Priya S.: will follow up with test owner in morning.
Jen ops: on it.
